_schema_notes: PLACEHOLDER DATA — this file is the weekly curation output. Every event needs a source_url (the venue post or page you verified it from) before verified can be true. date: YYYY-MM-DD. Expired events are hidden automatically by the app, so it is safe to leave past events in the file for a while. price: 0 = free, null = unknown.
_repeat_notes: OPTIONAL repeat: { weekly: ["thu"], until: null } marks a weekly fixture so it stops expiring after its first night. weekly = lowercase day codes, sun..sat. until = ISO date of the last occurrence, or null for open-ended. Leave date alone — it stays the occurrence source_url actually verified, and the app shows the next matching weekday instead (eventDate() in js/app.js). WARNING: until: null is a claim about the future that nothing here can keep true. A weekly night that quietly stops will keep rendering until someone re-reads the source and sets until. Re-check every repeating event in the weekly curation pass, the same as hours. Do NOT guess an until date to be safe — a wrong until hides a night that is still running, which is worse than showing one that ended last week.
